title: TagWeaver Privacy Policy
description: Privacy Policy for the TagWeaver app.
intro: This Privacy Policy applies to the TagWeaver app provided by ONNELLAB.
heading: Privacy Policy
opening: TagWeaver values your privacy. This app operates as described below.

blocks.value: TagWeaver does not require registration or sign-in with a name, email address, or phone number. Except for an optional server feature described below, app content and usage history are not transmitted to ONNELLAB.

sections.title: 2. Data accessed or stored on the device

items: MP3 files and metadata that the user explicitly selects
Artwork selected from the photo library or camera
App preferences and purchase entitlement stored on the device
Tag editing and artwork processing occur on the device.
Selected file contents are not uploaded to an ONNELLAB server.

blocks.value: The app features described above do not transmit file contents or usage history to an ONNELLAB server.

In-app purchases are processed by Apple App Store or Google Play. Neither TagWeaver nor ONNELLAB accesses or stores card or bank-account details. Product, transaction, and entitlement information supplied by the store may be used to verify and restore purchases.

TagWeaver does not use advertising SDKs, behavioral analytics SDKs, or third-party tracking tools. Data is not sold or shared outside the purposes described above. If the user deliberately hands content to another app or service through the operating-system share features, that service's policy applies.

App-managed local data can be removed through the applicable delete controls or by uninstalling the app. Source and output files controlled by the user remain under the user's control. ONNELLAB retains no app content on its servers.

ONNELLAB applies reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to data that must be transmitted. TagWeaver is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
If app functionality or legal or store requirements change, this document will be updated and its last-updated date will change.
Privacy questions or deletion requests: onnellab.app@gmail.com
